name: LawVu
description:
LawVu is the legal operating system for in-house corporate legal teams, combining matter management, contract lifecycle management, spend, intake, documents, and a knowledge base in one unified platform.

Connect Claude to the operational data your legal team relies on every day. Search and retrieve matters and contracts in natural language, generate status summaries and reports, retrieve answers grounded in your internal legal knowledge base, create new matters or intake requests, update matter status, and create tasks - all without leaving Claude.

You can also combine LawVu data with information from other connected systems, like CRM or HR platforms, for cross-system reporting and analysis.

Access is scoped to each user's own permissions and record access in LawVu and provides a full audit trail.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LawVu to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LawVu to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lawvu.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LawVu MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LawVu lists 51 MCP tools, including add_contract_status_message, add_field_option, add_matter_status_message, create_contract, create_matter, create_matter_conversation, create_matter_conversation_message, create_matter_legal_note, create_task, delete_contract_status_message, delete_legal_note, and delete_matter_conversation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LawVu?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LawVu in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
LawVu requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LawVu is developed by LawVu Limited. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
